description: Frozen B41. Learn a property-conditioned feasible edit region (x,p)→P(EDIT) on source atoms/bonds. Hard mask only. Not a planner: B41 still chooses WRITE/DELETE/SET. Birth quota unchanged. Paired-target masks are diagnostic, not optimal regions.
hypothesis: A learned feasible region beats per-molecule matched-count random and position-shuffled learned on real5, without RB collapsing.
claim_if_pass: learn where editing should remain possible
random_matched: per-molecule: same source-atom edit count and same source-source bond edit count as that molecule's learned hard mask. Not a dataset-average rate.
shuffled_learned: one random permutation of source atoms; bond mask conjugated by the same permutation. Preserves edit-subgraph shape and counts, not chemical location.
